oneLine: Solitario Lab Grown files DRHP for an IPO on BSE SME.

sources.title: Solitario Lab Grown Limited Filed DRHP With BSE SME

synopsis: Solitario Lab Grown Limited has filed its Draft Red Herring Prospectus with the SME Platform of BSE Limited for an initial public offering. The proposed IPO consists of a fresh issue of up to 65,00,000 equity shares and an offer for sale of up to 5,42,000 equity shares by the investor selling shareholder, Yashodhara Consultive LLP, bringing the total offered shares to 70,42,000 with a face value of ₹10 each. Proceeds from the fresh issue are intended to fund the setup of 20 new exclusive brand outlets, 75 new shop-in-shop counters in India, general corporate purposes, and issue-related expenses. Socradamus Capital Private Limited acts as the book running lead manager to the offer, while MUFG Intime India Private Limited serves as the registrar.
